main_text.l: 420. Paulinus Nolanus Episcopus.
Epist. 42. ad Cytherium de institutione filii agens.
In carne vivens vitâ carnis exulet, | Fœcunditatis congerens,
In lege mentis ambulans; | Exuberantum dives annorum bonis:
Totamque regni creditî terram sibi | Jejuna pavit tempora:
Peragret in libris sacris. | Sic iste noster in sacratis literis,
Et sicut ille vir Joseph Dei pius | Perambulet regnum Dei.
Memphiticos fines obit; | Scriptura namque sancto flata Spiritu,
Et ampliatis horreis lætas opes | Regui perennis mater est, &c.
Eidem tribuitur Epistola ad Celantiam Matronam, quæ 14. est in 1.
Tomo Operum Hieronymi. Illic de institutione matris familiæ agens.

page.notes: The footnote at the foot is set in two columns; the left column begins "9 Paulinus, Patriarcha Aquileiensis ... qui exeunte Seculo octavo florui, ex fide" and the right column continues "plurium Codicum MSS. quibus usi sunt Bene-dictini Parisienses." Some words there are damaged and read with uncertainty. The word "Præcipua" at the bottom right is a catchword. Left-margin mark "9" appears in the footnote, a small dot mark appears by "Clericus" and "sanctorum", and "Commentariis" has a mark near it, none transcribed as text.
